about_the_game:
Meet Menu is a cute and silly dating game about getting the most value out of your date who is paying for dinner!

Have you ever dreamed of ordering the most expensive thing on the menu, while your date picks up the check?
Welcome to Meet Menu, a silly restaurant adventure where charm, timing, and taste meet sky-high prices… without making your partner puke or run for the door! (Don’t worry -  you can upgrade them.)

Start from the bottom at a greasy restaurant and climb your way up to the most luxurious fine-dining experiences. Each date brings new menus, higher prices, and fancier restaurants than you have ever seen.

But be careful - ordering a gross combination of dishes can end the date early, while the perfect pairing will make the bill skyrocket!

  • Pick a partner with good qualities on the dating app

  • Go on dates and buy the most expensive stuff - but be careful to not hurt your partners feelings or make them sick

  • Upgrade Your Date! Level up your partner’s tolerance (and income) between dinners.

  • Enjoy ordering whatever you dream of, have fun, watch your partner squirm (or puke), and learn for the next round!
